notes.title: Move 'n' Bloom | PERMANENTLY FREE
notes.content: Move 'n' Bloom will be permanently free from 01.11.2023.

notes.title: Move 'n' Bloom - Linux version is out now!
notes.content:
What's new:
[list]
[*] Linux build of the game
[*] also a Linux build of the demo
[*] fixed the undo key for qwerty keyboard layout
[*] fixed small sprites issues in the credits view
[/list]

[i]Attention: the current Linux build was tested on Ubuntu 16.04 and 18.04.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38516195/9122565ac5f87551b8db241bedc94af4fa4ca1ea.png[/img]

notes.title: Move 'n' Bloom - v. 1.2.0
notes.content:
What's new:
[list]
[*] added auto undo, by holding the 'z' key down
[*] added some optional (more complex) puzzles for players who finished the game
[*] added one additional Achievement
[*] added Turkish language
[*] removed the limit of 18 undo's
[*] one of the previous hidden brocken Achievements is now achievable
[*] optimizations and small fixes
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38516195/9122565ac5f87551b8db241bedc94af4fa4ca1ea.png[/img]

notes.title: Move 'n' Bloom is out now!
notes.content:
It's cute, colorful and simple but also deceptively challenging!
Move 'n' Bloom combines a variety of match and Sokoban mechanics in a new and fresh way.

Sounds good!? Check it out now and enjoy playing!
